newsitem.title: GERMANY: Germany's Otto founds Shanghai mail order venture.
newsitem.headline: Germany's Otto founds Shanghai mail order venture.

text.p: Germany's Otto Versand, the world's largest mail order company, said on Tuesday that it had founded a joint venture to operate in China with the Shanghai Cheer Group.
The venture, the Shanghai-Otto-Cheer Mail Order Company Ltd, wants to build up business in the booming city of Shanghai and will publish its first sales catalogue in 1998, Otto said in a statement.
Privately-owned Otto Versand has annual turnover of 25 billion marks and has 56,000 workers. The Shanghai Cheer Group had 1995 sales of $225 million and employs 4,000.
Otto Versand will own 80 percent of the joint venture, which has founding capital of $6 million.
